title: Popover directive
description: Nonmodal anchored content. A TemplateRef supports arbitrary interactive content.
integration: Import the standalone PopoverDirective from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

configuration.label: Appearance
configuration.description: Overrides multiple visual properties for this instance.

configuration.label: StyleTokens
configuration.description: Overrides CSS theme tokens for this instance and its descendants.

configuration.label: Id
configuration.description: Supplies a stable identifier used by labels and descriptions. Here it is set to “custom-example”.

configuration.description: Controls whether the overlay is open. This example has it turned off. Open the example and try the relevant pointer or keyboard action.

configuration.label: OpenTrue

configuration.label: DisabledTrue
